title: Protoself, core self-awareness and the autobiographical self

statements.text: Core self-awareness is the basic component of self-awareness, grounded on the protoself, which includes primordial feelings of the living body. It gives a moment-to-moment sense of agency and ownership. Extended self-awareness adds an autobiographical self built on memory, and introspective self-awareness rests on metacognition.
statements.scope: Stated in Philippi et al. 2012 as a heuristic, citing Damasio for the protoself and the autobiographical self.
